_comment: Outer corners of the 8x8 playing area (the 64 squares; not the black ring, not the wooden frame) in 1920x1080 pixel coordinates, clockwise starting from the corner with the smallest x+y. Annotated on zoomed crops, accuracy about 3 px. Hidden corners were extrapolated along the visible thin printed boundary lines. Revised in milestone 5: the hidden far corners of 03 (second), 04 (first) and 05 (second) had been placed at the end of a visible boundary segment or one column off instead of at the intersection of the two boundary lines; they were re-annotated on zoomed crops (03 by intersecting the two visible thin boundary lines, 04 and 05 from the grid extrapolation, +-5 px at 1920).
